<!-- slot: abstract -->

Drift is correctable from the imaging data alone, and correcting it costs no acquisition channel.

<!-- slot: methods -->

Drift is estimated per round from the imaging data itself, with no fiducial channel acquired.

<!-- slot: results -->

The estimate is accurate enough to correct with, and correcting is cheap enough to run per round.

<!-- slot: results-accuracy -->

Residual displacement after correction stays under one pixel across every round.

<!-- slot: results-throughput -->

Correction adds under a second per round, which is inside the acquisition's own idle time.
